notes.title: Multiplayer update
notes.content: fixed several bugs related to lobby, gameplay and final score.

notes.title: The Joystick arrived
notes.content:
By popular request, we have added the ability to play with the Joystick, improving the gaming experience, but maintaining some functions and interface that require the use of a mouse (for now).

Bug Fixes


 Fixed several UI details and cinematics that did not disappear when they should.
 Tier 3 system fix: sliding band trap destroyed the player instead of taking life points, now fixed.
 Correction in the opening speed of one of the doors on level 3
 Review and correction of details in game cinematics.


Optimization


 We improved the quality of textures of several icons and characters, so that they will not load blurry
 Creation of LOD to reduce the polygons of trampolines and game platforms, which affected game performance.

notes.title: The Banaverse just got bigger
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44113978/90afaae2d51e9c9c3259f1fdfe156148d149fa10.jpg


Finally, the game with complete story mode is here, including the following content:

 Eleven levels full of action and comedy within their challenges.
 Variety of outfits distributed throughout the maps
 Item shop within each game level
 Hidden objects to use or collect
 Sticker system that you can stick throughout the game
 Interface and subtitles available in four languages ​​(Spanish, English, German and Portuguese)
 Art Gallery

Improvement notes:

 Optimized menu with language change, art gallery and subtitles.
 New tutorial shown when starting a new game provides better graphical information
 New inventory system to know what items you have

Bug Fixes:

General:
Improved underwater breathing system
Ragdoll system removed for aesthetic details
Interface implemented for the moment you lose the game
Fix in the CDT system
Adding coins, shop and other interaction objects

Level 1
Skip cutscenes button added to all levels
Improved level design to accommodate routing and more chasing 
Boss: code modification to make the encounter last longer
Boss: More enemies will appear during combat

Level 2
Modification in the door system, now they are detected more easily
Fixed the system of bars that open with a lever
Optimization in level properties
Redistribution of available items and currencies.

Level 3
Addition of challenges in sectors 1, 5 and 6
Review and improvement of functional details

Level 4
Improvement in challenge scenes
Improved stage decoration
More spaces to breathe

Level 5
Total redesign, now the level changed its appearance to a style more similar to a temple in the sand.
New challenges
Extension in the duration of the challenge

Multiverse
Modification to level design to include more portals
Modification of decorative objects

notes.title: Texture update
notes.content: Minor Texture size reduction to opimize resources over the LV4 map assets

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
General

 Pelo concha has arrived, the guide who gives you information about the missions and objectives, as well as clues and good jokes
 Texture optimization of game coins, now they are lighter in weight
 Improved data loading system, now you will have better progress saving
 Andrés no longer swims, the allied character will disappear as soon as he hits the water, and you will not be able to summon him while the player is submerged
 Added and improved the button to skip cinematics


Level 1:

 Fixed the gorilla so he always chases you
 Added voices to the fake Santa when he throws bombs at you
 Fixed level 1 construction to improve stage boundaries
 Added more enemies to improve the game difficulty


Level 2:

 Added more enemies to improve the game difficulty
 Fixed the construction of the space to improve the route
 Fixed some puzzle issues, the crank puzzle now properly registers when it is inserted and the challenge is solved
 


Level 3:

 Added more enemies to improve the game difficulty
 Decorations were added in the cargo room
 Optimization in challenges


Level 4:

 Maritime decor added to space to enhance aesthetics
 Some unnecessary barriers and obstacles were removed to improve the visual and route of the level
 The Poronga Fish arrives

notes.title: patch June 25th
notes.content:
Fixed the challenge in level 2 where you had to collect two cranks in order to access a point that opens a gate.

The timer for that gate was removed as it was unnecessary and caused technical difficulties.

notes.title: Notes Update June 23, 2023
notes.content:
The update considers the following changes:


 Automatic system to save progress: now it is possible to resume the game according to the progress of the game, with several established checkpoints.
Improved stage decoration to support player orientation
Revision and repair of challenge bugs, solved the puzzle of the pepigrones in the cage.
Add sfx to space objects
 Addition of background music for Isabel and CDT
Extension of levels 2 and 3, now they have a small extension to receive the special guest.
"El Peluca" has arrived! find him within the levels and receive his help to advance through the follies in the Banaverse

notes.title: Parche 01 -06
notes.content:
Se revisaron y repararon ciertos detalles del juego:

 El nivel 1 presentó dificultades en los elementos que marcan el límite del espacio.
 El gorila ahora no sale volando cuando recibe un golpe por items.
 Mejora en la IA de los enemigos
 nuevo sistema de música aplicado al nivel 1
